source: make a 3d deltarune inspired game with all the features deltarune has and in the overworld, make 2 people follow you (susie, and ralsei) add anything else thsts needed

answers.ask: The only style cue is the name of another game - should this read as bright and cartoony, or dark and storybook?
answers.answer: Use a dark storybook fantasy look with colorful cartoon characters and readable, playful environments, matching the Deltarune-inspired tone.

answers.ask: What is in the overworld besides the path - a town, dungeons, separate areas?
answers.answer: Build a small overworld with separate connected areas: a simple town hub, paths, and one dungeon area for the first playable slice.

answers.ask: Which features matter most: the walking overworld, the turn-based fights, or the story scenes?
answers.answer: Prioritize the walking overworld with Susie and Ralsei following the player, then simple turn-based fights; keep story scenes minimal.

config.genre_evidence: "all the features deltarune has," an "overworld," and two party members who "follow you" imply a party-based RPG layout with exploration as a secondary element.

extras.text: Two companion characters follow the player through the overworld.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this RPG map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Single Contiguous Map: Town, roads, and mob clearings all on one surface, no instanced areas.
